description_en: Queries the list and details of video stream push jobs, including the creation time, current push status, job type, and push URL
description_zh: 调用接口QueryStreamPushJobList查询视频推流任务列表及详情：创建时间、当前推流状态、任务类型、推流地址等
name: QueryStreamPushJobList

parameters.help_en: Specifies the number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100，默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to query the information of all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The DeviceName of the device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device. The ID is the unique identifier that is issued by IoT Platform to the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query the ID.

<notice> IotId is the unique identifier of the device and corresponds to the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can view instance ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview tab in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页的内容。默认值是起始页码1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The type of the stream push job. Valid values:

1 (default): continuous job.
2: triggered job. The job ends after it is interrupted
parameters.help_zh:
推流任务类型。

1（默认）：持续型任务。
2：触发式任务，中断后结束
parameters.name: job_type

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: The call was successful.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created. Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，单位为秒

JobType.description_en:
The type of the stream push job. Valid values:

1: continuous job.
2: triggered job. The job ends after it is interrupted
JobType.description_zh:
推流任务类型。

1：持续型任务。
2：触发式任务，中断后结束

PushStatus.description_en:
The current stream push status. Valid values:

1: pushing.
2: waiting to push.
3: push ended
PushStatus.description_zh:
当前推流状态。

1：正在推流。
2：等待推流。
3：推流结束

StreamType.description_en:
The stream type. Valid values:

0: main stream.
1: sub stream
StreamType.description_zh:
码流类型。

0：主码流 。
1：辅码流

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
